# How to Choose the Best CV Writing Service in Saudi Arabia (2026 Guide)

Searching for the best CV or resume writing service in Saudi Arabia? Most providers describe themselves as "the best", so this guide gives you a practical way to compare them: what a good service should include, what makes a CV ATS-friendly, what to ask before you pay, the warning signs to avoid, and what prices look like.

## Quick Answer
The best CV writing service in Saudi Arabia for you is one that has a person write your CV for your specific target role, delivers an ATS-friendly format, states its prices and revision terms upfront, and lets you discuss your CV before you pay. Start with a free CV review, then compare exactly what each package includes rather than the claims on the homepage.

## CV or Resume: Is There a Difference in Saudi Arabia?
In Saudi Arabia and across the GCC, employers and recruiters use "CV" and "resume" to mean the same thing: a document summarising your experience, skills and achievements for a job application. A "CV writing service" and a "resume writing service" in Saudi Arabia offer the same work. What matters is not the name but whether the document is clear, achievement-focused and tailored to the role.

## What a Good CV Writing Service in Saudi Arabia Should Include
- Human writing tailored to your target role, not a generic template filled in by software
- An achievement-focused rewrite that shows measurable results, not just a list of duties
- Role-specific keywords for the sectors you're targeting, such as engineering, construction, healthcare and technology
- A clean, ATS-friendly structure that both recruiters and screening software can read
- Clear revision terms, so you know how many rounds of changes are included
- Confidential handling of your CV and personal details

## Why an ATS-Friendly CV Matters in Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia's growth across engineering, construction, healthcare, technology and large-scale giga-projects means employers often rely on applicant tracking systems to manage large applicant pools. An ATS-optimized CV helps ensure your qualifications and experience are read clearly and matched to the right roles.

### ATS-friendly CV checklist
- A simple, single-column layout with standard section headings such as Summary, Experience, Skills and Education
- No important text inside images, text boxes or complex tables
- Keywords that match the job description, used naturally in your summary and experience
- Consistent job titles, dates and formatting throughout
- The file format the employer asks for, usually PDF or Word

## Questions to Ask Before You Choose
1. Who writes my CV: a person, or a template tool?
2. Will my CV be tailored to my target role and to employers in Saudi Arabia?
3. How many revisions are included, and how long does delivery take?
4. Will the format work with applicant tracking systems?
5. Can I discuss my CV before paying, for example through a free review?
6. Can I read reviews from real clients on an independent platform such as Google?

## Warning Signs to Avoid
- Guarantees of interviews or job offers: no CV writer can promise what an employer decides
- Prices that are not stated before you commit
- The same template for every client, regardless of role or country
- No chance to review a draft or ask for changes
- Reviews that cannot be checked anywhere outside the provider's own website

## How Much Does a CV Writing Service Cost in Saudi Arabia?
Prices vary by experience level and by what each package includes. As a reference point, BrandMyProfile's CV writing packages in Saudi Arabia start at 41 SAR (Essential), with Professional at 72 SAR and Executive at 102 SAR. The pricing page lists exactly what each package includes.

## How BrandMyProfile Works for Saudi Arabia Job Seekers

The process is simple: you start with a free CV review, choose the package that fits, a writer rewrites your CV for your target role, and you request revisions according to your package. Everything is handled online and over WhatsApp, so professionals in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Mecca, Medina or anywhere else in Saudi Arabia can work with us without visiting an office.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Which is the best CV writing service in Saudi Arabia?
There is no single best service for everyone. The right one writes your CV by hand for your target role, uses an ATS-friendly format, states prices and revisions upfront, and has reviews you can check independently. Compare two or three providers on those points before you decide.

### Is a CV the same as a resume in Saudi Arabia?
Yes. In Saudi Arabia the two words are used interchangeably for job applications. Focus on the content and structure rather than the label.

### How should I prepare a CV for Saudi Arabia jobs?
Present your experience with clear, industry-relevant keywords - particularly for engineering, construction, healthcare or technology roles - and keep the structure straightforward so both recruiters and any screening systems used by Saudi employers can review it easily.

### What is an ATS CV?
An ATS CV is a CV formatted so that applicant tracking systems can read it correctly: a clean layout, standard headings, no important text inside images, and keywords that match the job description. It still needs to read well to the recruiter who sees it next.
